1) a hybrid rendering pipeline that combines rasterization and raycasting can improve the rendering performance of high resolution triangle meshes and isosurfaces, 2) the performance of raycasting-based rendering can be improved significantly when the ray traversal algorithm is optimized for the specific data structure used, 3) a memory-efficient samplebased data structure can be used for both rasterization and raytracing, and 4) a regular model subdivision can be used to optimize the rendering pipeline at run-time

1) a sample-based data structure can efficiently represent the surface of large models and can be used to efficiently perform ray traversal; 2) a regular model subdivision allows to select the optimal rendering technique for each part; 3) the proposed method outperforms rasterization-based rendering in terms of rendering speed and memory usage.
